text.en: 1. This Notification is the Exchanges (Demutualisation and Merger) (Designated Companies) Notification 1999.

2. For the purposes of section 3(2) of the Act —
(a)the transferee holding company is Singapore Exchange Limited; and
(b)the special purpose company is SEL Holdings Pte Ltd.
